expectedBehavior: R3 design selects one non-trivial outcome-oriented exact workspaceKey lookup candidate but cannot convert it into approved product truth without Dexter acceptance.

GATE_0_READINESS is a real temporal predecessor of business source; Dexter publishes an immutable checkpoint commit and later targets prove descent before contract/generated and Flyway production conformity.
The runtime remains one Nginx ingress, one stateless Spring Boot application and one PostgreSQL database with three owner schemas and one global Flyway history.
Operations login crosses the owner boundary only through platform-workspace.api in the same REQUIRED transaction; schema and command dependency graphs remain acyclic.
Eight OpenAPI operations are sliced as server=8, platform=5 and operations=3, including face-specific current-session bootstrap and app-local reachable types.
The platform workspace check is one page with exact workspaceKey lookup and read-only detail confirmation, owner readback and explicit failure states.
Two principal systems have distinct requests, cookies, session stores, current-session bootstrap, filters and owners; bootstrap schemas are minimal and keep 401 separate from network or 5xx.

Browser forgery uses server-managed per-face canonical origins, fixed edge-to-forgery-to-auth ordering, exact Origin and conditional Fetch Metadata fallback, with no CORS allow headers or dual CSRF implementation.
Dynamic evidence is proxy-only and run-scoped; business and cleanup remain separate and cleanup requires zero active resources.
The implementation-facing design handoff uses a real hash, anchor, delivery-unit, finding, verdict and review-round production validator with shared-core red fixtures.
Design review authorizes no application, migration, DEV, database, browser or Git write.

findings.title: The real-page candidate is implementable but is not yet approved product truth
findings.evidence: The frozen Roadmap requires an approved walking-skeleton Journey but the current Heritage denominator contains no exact page entry. Independent review confirmed that navigation alone is not a user outcome, so the design now proposes an exact workspaceKey registration-status check while retaining DEXTER_ACCEPTANCE_REQUIRED_BEFORE_IMPLEMENTATION.
findings.risk: Treating design authorization as page approval would let architecture invent product scope and could build the wrong real page.
findings.disposition: Dexter must explicitly accept R3-J01 or choose an alternative. Any alternative must revise owner, wire, UI, data, test and generated-slice surfaces and be re-reviewed.

findings.title: The backend core candidates are exact but build and frontend version sets remain deliberately deferred
findings.evidence: The design records exact official candidates for Boot, OpenAPI Generator and Boot-managed Flyway/Testcontainers, while ArchUnit, Gradle and frontend versions are DEFERRED_EXACT_VERSION_SET.
findings.risk: Implementation from memory could select incompatible APIs or silently produce two version lines.
findings.disposition: Fill one spike decision and lockfiles before GATE_0; a hard incompatibility requires one new decision.

findings.title: The first review records old input hashes but the untracked historic bytes are not recoverable
findings.evidence: The first reviewer recorded design and manifest SHA-256 values and its findings, but those paths were untracked and mutated before an immutable snapshot, Git blob or commit was created.
findings.risk: A future reviewer cannot independently recompute the exact first-round input bytes.
findings.disposition: Do not fabricate a reconstructed snapshot. Preserve the hashes and reviewer report; future review cycles bind an immutable snapshot/blob before mutation.

solutionReasonableness.problemFit: The design proves the actual target topology and owner/consumer boundaries with one outcome-oriented exact lookup and detail confirmation rather than substituting health or static shell evidence.
solutionReasonableness.simplerAlternativeAssessment: A /me or health page is smaller but cannot prove workspace task read or owner readback; current-session endpoints remain supporting infrastructure. Two full admin Journeys cost more without adding a necessary R3 oracle.
solutionReasonableness.costFit: Three owner modules and eight operations are the minimum refresh-safe two-principal shape that avoids a union login contract, cross-owner DML and a fake operations business page.

conclusion.summary: After two Codex adversarial rounds and dialectical resolution, the implementation design is concrete, bounded and technically coherent. The cycle is SELF_DECIDED and cannot start a third Codex round. The required granularity checker now passes production and red controls; the only major blocker is Dexter acceptance of the proposed product entry.
conclusion.authorizationBoundary: This same-session review is not independent and authorizes no R3/W1 implementation, GATE_0 code, application, contract, migration, DEV, seed/reset, database, dynamic evidence or Git write.
